title: Bayesian posterior over Mirror angle versus Rank-1 weight posterior
hypothesis: A scalar posterior over a functional Mirror angle can match rank-one Gaussian weight posterior predictive quality/calibration with fewer posterior bytes on a low-dimensional logistic task.
physical_object: shared 2D logistic classifier with fixed-radius directional weight orbit
logical_multiplicity: sampled probabilistic classifiers from one shared physical vector

task.teacher: Bernoulli logistic with weight radius 1.2 and angle uniform in [0.2,0.8]; OOD inputs shifted by +1.0 on feature 1 and scaled 1.5 on feature 2

controls: Rank-1 BNN-style Gaussian perturbation w=mu+a*z, z scalar Gaussian

storage.authority: actual deterministic serialized inference payload bytes
paid_objects: Mirror posterior parameters or Rank-1 factor/posterior parameters

success_gate: Mirror NLL within 0.02 of Rank-1 on IID and OOD; ECE within 0.02; at least 20% fewer actual posterior bytes.
failure_gate: Quality/calibration misses or payload reduction below 20%.
boundaries: not a Rank-1 BNN reproduction or natural-data evaluation
posterior fit on train data only
